page_title: GET 0-0 BAR | Getafe v Barcelona 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' Cesar Soto Grado is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+16' Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
90+16' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Choco Lozano (Getafe), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
90+15' The referee shows a yellow card to Portu (Getafe). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+14' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Barcelona! Play can continue.
90+13' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Barcelona! Let's see what he decides.
90+11' Gavi (Barcelona) attempts to discuss the decision with Cesar Soto Grado, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+11' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+8' Djene (Getafe) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+6' Djene (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
90+6' Djene (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
90+1' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Djene (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona). Cesar Soto Grado saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
87' The corner from Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
84' Choco Lozano (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' 4:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
82' Damian Suarez (Getafe) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
80' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies just over the crossbar, almost brushing it.
79' Xavi decides to make a substitution. Pedri will be replaced by Ansu Fati (Barcelona).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gavi (Barcelona) comes onto the pitch for Ilkay Gundogan.
78' The linesman raises his flag. Choco Lozano (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
77' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
76' Oriol Romeu will be replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
75' Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
72' The referee blows for a cooling break.
70' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Xavi, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
69' The fouls committed statistics – 13:7.
65' Flag goes up against Borja Mayoral (Getafe) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Choco Lozano (Getafe) replaces Carles Alena.
64' It's time for a substitution. Borja Mayoral (Getafe) comes on in place of Juanmi Latasa.
63' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
62' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) plants a goal-bound header towards the right post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders reacts superbly and makes a timely interception.
61' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.

59' Pedri (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.

57' Jaime Mata (Getafe) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Cesar Soto Grado shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
56' The resulting corner from Carles Alena (Getafe) is cleared.
54' The attendance for today's match is 13410.
53' Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
52' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Cesar Soto Grado signals a set piece.
49' Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' Half-time substitution. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) will not participate anymore and Abde Ezzalzouli is coming on.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Portu has come on in place of Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+11' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' Carles Alena (Getafe) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
45+8' Jaime Mata (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+7' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:6.
45+5' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle after Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
45+2' Some great controlled play and passing from Barcelona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
45' Djene (Getafe) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
42' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
40' Raphinha (Barcelona) steps up to send the ball in.
40' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
38' Carles Alena (Getafe) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
38' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
37' The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
37' The ball is crossed into the box and Raphinha (Barcelona) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria gets a glove on it to thwart him.
36' A spell of possession for Barcelona in an attempt to control the game.
33' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
31' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

30' That was a nice football moment. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Marc-Andre ter Stegen guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
29' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
25' Flag up against Carles Alena (Getafe). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Djene (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
23' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
21' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
18' Damian Suarez (Getafe) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
17' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).
16' Raphinha (Barcelona) sees his mid-range free kick perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. Now Barcelona have a corner.
15' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
14' The Barcelona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 20:80.
11' A pass by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
6' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
2' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Raphinha (Barcelona) offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will referee today's match.
